ideas.pitch: A specialized enumeration and web exploit dashboard tailored for CTF bug bounty competitions to rapidly map out endpoints and surface common misconfigurations.
ideas.problem_statement: About Bug Bounty - Challenge-based Bug Bounty / CTF competition focusing on web exploits and responsible vulnerability discovery.
ideas.title: FlagScope: Automated Recon & Vulnerability Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the fast-paced competitive leaderboard nature of the event by automating tedious reconnaissance, freeing up the team to focus on logic flaws and high-value flags.

ideas.pitch: A localized containerized environment that simulates real-world vulnerable network topologies and attack paths for training and testing exploits safely.
ideas.problem_statement: About Bug Bounty - Real-world security scenarios with varying difficulty levels and challenge-based CTF formats.
ideas.title: NetSim-CTF: Real-Time Network Attack Sandbox
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the pattern of solving genuinely hard engineering problems, providing advanced visualization and simulation capabilities similar to top hackathon winners.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent static analysis helper that scans codebase snippets, identifies potential exploits, and suggests secure code patches on the fly.
ideas.problem_statement: About Bug Bounty - Focus on ethical hacking, web exploits, and responsible vulnerability discovery.
ideas.title: SecurePatch: AI-Powered Vulnerability Remediation Tool
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines offensive security identification with defensive remediation, giving judges a complete lifecycle perspective on bug bounties.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight proxy and runtime inspection tool designed to detect and block SQL injection, XSS, and command injection payloads in real time.
ideas.problem_statement: About Bug Bounty - Participants may attack only the event application with focus on web exploits.
ideas.title: PayloadShield: Local WAF and Exploit Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates deep understanding of defensive security mechanisms against the exact type of web exploits featured in the CTF challenges.

ideas.pitch: An independent, high-performance scoreboard interface that parses live challenge difficulty metrics, first-blood bonuses, and team standing adjustments.
ideas.problem_statement: About Bug Bounty - Dynamic live leaderboard for participant rankings and challenge-based CTF competition.
ideas.title: CTF-Tracker: Dynamic Leaderboard & Submission Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases exceptional systems engineering and real-time data handling, fulfilling core infrastructure needs for competitive hackathons.
